info.senderName: Xinlin District Meteorological Warning Issuing Officer
info.headline: Xinlin District Meteorological Observatory issues yellow warning for road ice and snow [Level III/Heavy]
info.description: The Xinlin District Meteorological Observatory issued a yellow warning signal for road ice and snow at 07:06 on November 12, 2026: It is expected that the road surface temperature will be below 0 ℃ in the next 24 hours, with rainy and snowy weather, and there will be road icing or snow accumulation, which will have a certain impact on traffic.

area.areaDesc: 1. Transportation, public security and other departments should prepare for road icing or snow accumulation according to their responsibilities;

info.senderName: 新林区气象预警签发员
info.headline: 新林区气象台发布道路冰雪黄色预警[III级/较重]
info.description: 新林区气象台2026年11月12日07时06分发布道路冰雪黄色预警信号：预计未来24小时内，路表温度低于0℃，有雨雪天气，将出现道路结冰或积雪，对交通有一定影响。 防御指南： 1.交通、公安等部门要按照职责做好道路结冰或积雪的应对准备工作； 2.驾驶人员应当注意路况，安全行驶； 3.行人外出尽量少骑自行车，注意防滑。
